_meta.description: Complaint/demand/dispute templates. Legal basis, addressee, and framing are FIXED here (not AI-generated). The generator fills only the {{fact}} slots with the user's details. Redact by default. Not legal advice.

odpc_data_complaint.title: Data protection complaint (ODPC)
odpc_data_complaint.addressee: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
odpc_data_complaint.legal_basis: Data Protection Act, 2019 (Article 31, Constitution of Kenya); Data Protection (Complaints Handling Procedure and Enforcement) Regulations, LN 264/2021.
odpc_data_complaint.not_advice: This is a self-prepared complaint, not legal advice. Verify details before filing.

cbk_conduct_complaint.title: Digital lender conduct report (CBK)
cbk_conduct_complaint.addressee: Central Bank of Kenya — Digital Credit Providers supervision
cbk_conduct_complaint.legal_basis: Central Bank of Kenya Act s.33S; Central Bank of Kenya (Digital Credit Providers) Regulations, 2022.
cbk_conduct_complaint.not_advice: This is a self-prepared report, not legal advice.

cak_consumer_complaint.title: Consumer complaint — misleading terms (CAK)
cak_consumer_complaint.legal_basis: Competition Act (consumer protection: false/misleading representations, unconscionable conduct); Article 46, Constitution of Kenya (consumer right to information).
cak_consumer_complaint.body:
To the Competition Authority of Kenya,

I wish to complain about {{lender_name}} concerning misleading representations in a loan/financing product.

I was told: {{what_told}}. The actual terms were: {{actual_terms}}. The true cost was not adequately disclosed to me before signing.

I request that the Authority investigate this conduct under the Competition Act and Article 46.

Case reference (my record): {{case_ref}}

Yours faithfully,
{{redacted_name}}
cak_consumer_complaint.not_advice: This is a self-prepared complaint, not legal advice.

repossession_demand.title: Demand letter — wrongful repossession
repossession_demand.legal_basis: Kenyan courts have held that repossession without a valid default notice and lawful process is illegal, null and void (e.g. High Court rulings, 2024).
repossession_demand.not_advice: This is a self-prepared demand letter, not legal advice. Consider consulting a lawyer or legal aid; whether repossession was unlawful depends on your contract and the facts.

crb_dispute.title: CRB listing dispute
crb_dispute.legal_basis: Banking (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2020 (Legal Notice 55 of 2020).
crb_dispute.not_advice: This is a self-prepared dispute, not legal advice.
